ADOBE CORE14 FONT METRICS: ORIGINAL NOTICES AND MODIFICATIONS

NOTICE OF MODIFICATION: This is a reduced JSON representation of Adobe Core14 AFM metrics generated by @pdf-lib/standard-fonts and stored as a base64-encoded zlib stream, not an original Adobe AFM file. Orchestra adds only this attribution field to the decoded metric object during runtime staging. All pre-existing metric fields, including the original Adobe copyright and trademark Notice, are unchanged. See the accompanying pdf-adobe-core14-mustread.html.txt and pdf-adobe-core14-notices.txt for the unchanged permission and original notices.

Upstream transformation: selected AFM fields, character widths/names, and kerning pairs are parsed to JSON; character C, B, and L fields are omitted; JSON is zlib-compressed and base64-encoded. The following notices are copied from the original AFM Notice lines and are also retained unchanged in every corresponding decoded metric object. No font outline files are distributed by this package. The Adobe permission is retained unchanged in pdf-adobe-core14-mustread.html.txt.
